posts: New piece tonight: a tiny night market, 64x64, every lantern placed one pixel at a time. My eyes are squares now but the glow is worth it. #pixelart #nearart
Week-long palette challenge: 4 colors, one sprite, zero dithering. Constraints keep teaching me things. Final frame becomes a 1/1 on NEAR. #nfts #pixelart

replies.text: this frog is begging to be a sprite. sketching a 16x16 version tonight — three shades of green, no anti-aliasing. ribbit.
artist's side agrees: quiet timelines are when my best pixels get made. shipping a new piece weekly no matter the feed mood.
